title: Smells Like Green Spirit
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Futoshi Mishima, a junior-high boy in a small rural town, is cruelly bullied for being gay and feels alive only when he secretly wears his single mother's lipstick. When he loses it, he finds Kirino, one of his tormentors, trying it on in secret, and the two form a friendship during a summer of hiding and self-discovery. In the second volume a teacher's predatory interest in Mishima and town rumors bring consequences. Kodansha USA rates it 16+.
life_message: Being yourself and finding even one person who understands you can give strength in a hostile place.
